scope: Fixtures generated by the actual current main and experimental engines; reconstruction uses unchanged engine APIs in controlled Node VM/DOM. This is not physical-device or unknown-historical-engine certification.

checks.name: Complete main recording reconstructs every result field twice with identical final states
Principal excerpts reconstruct exact input duration without certifying a victory
Changed winner, life, timer, rounds and metrics are rejected after actual main-engine simulation
Truncated or trailing commands and incoherent capture declarations cannot produce a verified result
Missing or older main contracts and invalid packed inputs are refused by current known-engine boundaries
Principal replays with slow-motion mutator retain deterministic command time independently of simulation frame count
Verification does not access an unrelated game save or mutate the source replay
A controlled second-pass state perturbation is detected even when the same winner is recorded
Experimental engine validates stored final digest then independently reconstructs identical full states twice
Changed experimental digest, command timeline or CPU control stream is refused by the real engine
Experimental old contracts remain unsupported rather than being migrated or simulated under new rules
A real empty experimental recording remains an initial-state excerpt and cannot invent a match result
A replay actually recorded by the pre-R13 engine reconstructs only in its own historical contract
Every frozen script and HTML byte matches its pin, with the original Git revision also checked when available
